reviews.comment: Dr. Thakar was great! Her lectures are fun, and she cancelled class every Friday. There are 3 weekly assignments each week that are easy, but they just take some time to complete.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is really really nice, a great teacher, and this class is incredibly easy. No exams and an easy A. As long as you have a little bit of work ethic you will be totally fine. I barely remembered that I was even in the class. Take it!

This was the easiest class I've taken! The instructor is kind, engaging, and truly cares about her students. There were no exams, and the online assignments were straightforward. I'd definitely take her class again; it was enjoyable. She does have assigned seating that changes weekly, which has helped me meet amazing people.

She is very kind and passionate about the subject; you can tell she knows what she's talking about. It's very easy to get an A if you come to class and participate in discussions. She knows everyone by name, and she notices those who participate more. It's a very interesting subject, and I actually enjoyed attending class.

I am not sure she knows human evolution so I don't know why she's teaching it as part of Anth 204. She kept calling human fossils by wrong names even though the right names were on the slides. I went in expecting a lot more but I was very disappointed. She's an easy grader and very kind, but I wasn't impressed.
Awesome loved the material she taught just wasn't a interesting subject but learned plenty of information in a clear manner.

I loved her teaching style! She was always super interactive and fun! You can tell she is so passionate about anthro so it really engages you.There are no tests so it's mainly assignments and readings which can be time consuming but not difficult in any way. If you're confused just ask her! She is super nice and approachable!

Dr. Thakar really enjoyed teaching her subject, however outside of class it was hard to get a hold of her. There were no exams in her classes, but there were 6 assignments due each week. She never gave us our grades on time, I only had 1/2 of my grades when class ended. That was the main reason I rated her what I did.

Dr. Thakar made class fun by talking about interesting things. She is very passionate about her works and what she is teaching and wants you to be engaged too. I took the five-week summer course and expectations were communicated.

Graded assignments could not be kept as you were required to turn them back in after reviewing in class, lectures given by other students, took until the last 3 weeks to actually teach, disconnection between TA grader and prof, grades never accessible, bad teaching made the final project a nightmare. 0/10. I will never take a class with her again.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She does not teach. Other students are in charge of "presenting" the information we learned solely from the textbook. That was our only source of info. She does NOT teach you how to use R which is the BIGGEST thing in the class. After 16 weeks, I still know nothing about how to use/understand the R program. She's nice though, that's her only plus
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She loves anthropology and she is extremely passionate about it. You will have to try for the class. She has gone over my papers with me during her office hours so thoroughly and patiently, no other teachers has ever put that much effort into helping me write. Just make sure that you're not a sensitive about her feedbacks.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Wonderful prof! Some students may perceive her as difficult because she can be very hands off in student projects and expects students to do the work themselves, often with little guidance. However, she is always available for questions outside of class if need be. I have learned more from her class than any other time in my undergrad.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Challenging at times but that was the format of the class. Weekly reading & annotations are required (takes usually 3-4 hrs, maybe more) for group discussion. Enjoyed the class and reflects well in the future studies.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She oversees the museum studies minor. This course is required for it. Even through the asinine assignments, vague instructions, outdated readings, and horrible forced student discussions, I managed to come out knowing even less about careers in museum studies and completely discouraged from the museum studies program entirely. Avoid her!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: From the start, Dr. Thakar is very apparently enthusiastic and educated in the subject matter. However, the extreme expectations coupled with the ridiculously vague guidelines made for a nigh impossible A, much less something easily passed.

This class would have been challenging on its own, but her instruction made it 100% more difficult and unclear. She encouraged us to ask her for help, but when we did she was condescending and I left more confused than before. I actually think I would have enjoyed the subject material and text if I had learned it from literally anyone else but her.

so much work! The 1st weekend we were assigned over 140+ pages of reading that was mandatory in order to pass the daily quizzes. we finished the 1st textbook from front to back in less than 2 weeks. attendance is mandatory bc she gives quizzes everyday @ the beginning of class so you cant be late. about two essays a week. participation is mandatory
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS
